rv.q: Citadel Theatre has definitely done it again with this hilarious spoof of the Broadway musical genre.
Tina Denmark is a bad seed that sprouting great fun.
For audiences looking for something unconventional—a musical that leans into satire, camp, and the unexpected— Ruthless! offers a theatrical experience unlike most.
The play’s title says it all: “Ruthless!” eviscerates cherished plays, performers and institutions alike, while communicating a love of the art form that is unmistakable.
Ruthless! at Citadel Theatre is a wickedly entertaining romp—equal parts satire and homage, served with a generous helping of theatrical flair.
This is a play that you WANT to see!
Bob Bullen's performance alone is worth the trip.

cn.t: Critics enthusiastically embrace this deliciously wicked satire, praising its sharp send-up of stage mothers and showbiz ambition, with over-the-top charm and razor-sharp wit that lovingly skewers classic musicals.
